current_text: An affidavit of service, which the rules list as one way to prove that a document was served.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 6B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate from a lawyer or paralegal, which the rules list as one way to prove that a document was served, where the lawyer or paralegal served it or caused it to be served.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 6C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An automatic order that the court clerk issues when certain claims are made, and gives to the party making the claim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8.0.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An application form a person files to start a divorce case.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An application form a person files to start a child protection case or a status review case.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An application form filed to start a status review for a child in extended society care or a child formerly in extended society care.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8B.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The general application form for cases under the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017, other than child protection and status review cases.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8B.2; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An application form a person files to start a case about secure treatment.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An application form a person files to start an adoption case.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An application form filed to ask the court to go ahead without (dispense with) a parent's consent to adoption before the child is placed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8D.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice, served under the Act, that a child is intended to be placed for adoption.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8D.2; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice that a First Nations, Inuk or Métis child is intended to be placed for adoption. It is served on the child and on a representative chosen by each of the child's bands and First Nations, Inuit or Métis communities.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8D.3; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A reply a party may serve and file to respond to a claim made in an answer. The rules say this may be done within 10 days after being served with an answer.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 10A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A financial statement used when a case includes a property claim, with or without a support claim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 13.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate a party serves together with financial disclosure documents to confirm they were served, and then files before a case conference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 13A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A net family property statement, which a party in a case with a property claim under Part I of the Family Law Act serves and files.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 13B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Compares the parties' net family property statements. The parties file one together before a settlement conference, or if they cannot agree, each party serves and files their own.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 13C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The general affidavit form. The rules say a motion requires a notice of motion and an affidavit, and the rules also use this form in other situations.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A motion form that may be used instead of a notice of motion and affidavit when a motion is limited to procedural, uncomplicated or unopposed matters. The rules also require or allow it for certain other motions they name.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A confirmation of motion that a party gives to the clerk, after giving a copy to every other party. If it is no longer correct, a corrected confirmation is given.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An order made on a motion without notice. The rules say it requires the matter to come back to the court and, if possible, to the same judge, within 14 days or on a date chosen by the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a party who does not agree to a requested change to a final order or agreement, or who wants the court to make an additional or different change.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 15B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Filled in by a party who agrees to a requested change to a final order or agreement, or when the parties agree to a different change.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 15C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used when the parties, and any assignee, agree to change a final order or agreement only in relation to a child support obligation. The rules say parties who bring the motion this way do not need to serve or file financial statements.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 15D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The general case conference brief used for a case conference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The case conference brief used for a case conference in a protection application or status review.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The general settlement conference brief used for a settlement conference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The settlement conference brief used for a settlement conference in a protection application or status review.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The brief used for a trial management conference held in the Ontario Court of Justice.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A confirmation of conference that a party gives to the clerk, after giving a copy to every other party (except in a child protection case). If it is no longer correct, a corrected confirmation is given.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate of dispute resolution. Each party files one as a condition for a judge to order that a case conference and settlement conference be combined after the parties used family mediation or a legal aid settlement conference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An authorization the clerk issues, where necessary, to a commissioner who is to supervise a questioning outside Ontario.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 20A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A letter of request the clerk issues, where necessary, asking a court or authorities outside Ontario for help getting a person to come before the commissioner to be questioned.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 20B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An acknowledgement of the expert's duty, signed by the expert. The rules say it is included with an expert's report.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 20.2; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A response to a request to admit, used to deny or refuse to admit a fact or document. Unless a party serves a response within 20 days, the party is considered to have admitted it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 22A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A summons to a witness outside Ontario under the Interprovincial Summonses Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 23A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A court order to a prisoner's custodian to deliver the prisoner, when the prisoner needs to come to court or to be questioned.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 23B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit that may be used as evidence at an uncontested trial, unless the court directs that oral evidence be given.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 23C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form for a divorce order. The rules say the party in whose favour an order is made prepares a draft of it, unless the court orders otherwise.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form for a secure treatment order. The rules say the party in whose favour an order is made prepares a draft of it, unless the court orders otherwise.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form for an adoption order. The rules say the party in whose favour an order is made prepares a draft of it, unless the court orders otherwise.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form for an order made after an uncontested trial. The rules say the party in whose favour an order is made prepares a draft of it, unless the court orders otherwise.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served by a party who disagrees with the form or content of a draft order, together with a copy of the order redrafted as proposed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: One of the two forms (25F or 25G) in which a restraining order under the Children's Law Reform Act or the Family Law Act is made.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for a restraining order made on a motion without notice.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for an order that ends (terminates) a restraining order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25H; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit filed with the sheriff or clerk that sets out items of expense.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 26A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit used to file a domestic contract with the court under the Family Law Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 26B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice sent immediately by a person who continues an enforcement after it is transferred between a recipient and the Director under subrule (12) or (13), to all parties to the enforcement, to the clerk at every court office involved, and to every sheriff involved.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 26C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit used to file a family arbitration award for support with the court under the Family Law Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 26D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A request a recipient may serve on an income source of the payor, when a payment order is in default, requiring the income source to send the recipient a statement of income.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 27A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statement of income that a payor's income source prepares and sends to the recipient after receiving a request, when a payment order is in default.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 27B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An appointment a recipient may serve on the payor when a payment order is in default, requiring the payor to come to a financial examination and bring documents or things named in it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 27C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Filed by a recipient, along with a statement of money owed, to ask the clerk to issue a writ of seizure and sale.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 28A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statutory declaration to the sheriff. The rules say it may be filed with the sheriff when a court changes a payment order that is being enforced by a writ of seizure and sale.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 28B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A writ the court may, on a motion with special service, give permission to issue, directing the sheriff to take and hold all or part of the land and other property of a person against whom an order has been made, and any income from it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 28C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of garnishment for a lump-sum debt. The clerk issues it when a recipient files a request for garnishment and a statement of money owed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of garnishment for a periodic debt. The clerk issues it when a recipient files a request for garnishment and a statement of money owed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice the garnishee sends to another person who co-owns a debt being garnished, by mail, fax or email to that person's address in the garnishee's records.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statutory declaration a recipient may serve on the garnishee and the payor, and file with the court, setting out the new amount to be paid when a support order indexes payments for inflation.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form a payor uses to dispute a notice of garnishment or a statutory declaration of indexed support, served on the other parties and filed with the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form a garnishee uses to dispute a notice of garnishment or a statutory declaration of indexed support, served on the other parties and filed with the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form a co-owner of a debt uses to dispute a notice of garnishment or a statutory declaration of indexed support, served on the other parties and filed with the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of a hearing about a garnishment. The clerk issues it on request after a dispute is served and filed, or if the recipient says the garnishee has not paid any money or enough money.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29H; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Sent by a recipient to the garnishee and payor, and filed with the clerk, to stop a garnishment when the recipient no longer wants to enforce by garnishment, or periodic payments have ended and all other amounts owing have been paid.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29I; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statement to garnishee financial institution re support. It accompanies the notice of garnishment and further notices when the garnishee is a financial institution under the Bank Act, Cooperative Credit Associations Act or Trust and Loan Companies Act and the garnishment enforces a support order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29J; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Filed by a recipient who is enforcing a support order, along with a statement of money owed, to ask the clerk to issue a notice of default hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 30A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form a payor serves on the recipient and files, together with a financial statement, after being served with a notice of default hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 30B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served by a person asking the court's permission to enforce a bond, with a copy of the bond attached, on the person said to have broken the bond and on each surety.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 32A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A warrant for arrest. One use in the rules is to bring before the court a witness who was served with a summons as the rules require and did not obey it, when it is necessary to have the witness present in court or at a questioning.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 32B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit a party uses to support a motion for a warrant of committal, for example stating that a person in contempt has not obeyed a condition the court imposed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 32C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The warrant of committal issued to enforce an order of imprisonment.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 32D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Filed by a person entitled to enforcement of a family arbitration award to ask the court to enforce it, together with the family arbitration agreement, the certificates of independent legal advice, and the award.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 32.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form a respondent serves on every other party and files to oppose a request to enforce a family arbitration award.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 32.1A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The warrant, in a child protection case, to bring a child to a place of safety.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The plan of care for a child used by a children's aid society in a child protection case, whether the society is the applicant or a respondent giving its answer.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used in a child protection case by a party other than a children's aid society to set out its plan of care for a child and, if it is a respondent, its answer.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33B.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The answer a respondent uses in cases under the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017 other than child protection and status review, such as an application for an openness order or to change or end one.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33B.2; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statement of the facts the parties agree on in a child protection case.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statement of the facts the parties agree on in a status review application.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The application used to start a case to publish something or make it public under O. Reg. 155/18 of the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33D.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A consent to publishing something or making it public under O. Reg. 155/18 of the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33D.2; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The answer a respondent serves and files in response to an application to publish or make public under O. Reg. 155/18 of the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33D.3; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The consent signed by the child in an application for secure treatment under the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The consent signed by a person other than the child in an application for secure treatment under the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 33F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit of parentage, filed with an adoption application when the child is not in extended society care. The rules accept it or any other evidence about parentage that the court requires from the child's parent or a person named by the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A consent to a child's adoption, used in an adoption case when the applicant has a spouse who has not joined in the application.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statement on an adoption from a Director or local director, filed in an adoption case when the Act or an order requires it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit signed by an adoption applicant giving details about their education, work, health, background, ability to care for the child, relationship with the child, and whether the child is a First Nations, Inuk or Métis person.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A Director's consent to adoption, filed with an adoption application when the child is in extended society care.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A consent to adoption under section 180 of the Act from each parent, other than the applicant, known to the person placing the child or an applicant. Filed when the child is not in extended society care and is placed by a licensee or children's aid society.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit signed by the adoption licensee or an authorized children's aid society employee, depending on who is placing the child. It is filed with an adoption application when the child is not in extended society care and is placed by a licensee or society.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit signed by a children's aid society employee in the adoption of a child who is in extended society care.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34G.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit from each applicant in a family adoption, filed when the child was a resident of Canada before being placed for adoption. For an applicant who is not a parent of the child, it contains a broad record check or proof that one was requested.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34H; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: In a family adoption of a child resident in Canada before placement, an affidavit from each person over 18, other than an applicant or child, who lives with a non-parent applicant and is not a parent of the child. It contains a broad record check or proof of request.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34H.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The consent of a child's parent when the parent's spouse applies to adopt the child.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34I; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Completed by a representative of the Children's Lawyer who witnesses the adoption consent of a parent who is under the age of 18 years.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34J; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate the clerk prepares in an adoption case after reviewing the application and other documents to see whether they are in order, before it goes to a judge.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34K; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The application used to start a case asking the court for an openness order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34L; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A consent to an openness order under section 194 of the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34M; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A consent to an openness order under section 196 or 197 of the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, 2017.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34M.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The application used to start a case asking the court to change or end an openness order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34N; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit a party claiming decision-making responsibility, parenting time or contact with a child serves and files with the claim. A non-parent claiming decision-making responsibility attaches a police records check or other proof set out in the rules.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 35.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit filed with a claim for decision-making responsibility, parenting time or contact when the child or any party has been involved in a child protection case or received services from a child protection agency. It is not filed in the continuing record.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 35.1A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate the clerk prepares in a divorce case before presenting the documents to a judge.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 36A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The divorce certificate issued once the matters set out in the rules are satisfied. Unless the court orders otherwise, it is mailed to the parties if stamped envelopes were filed, or emailed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 36B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An information sheet the clerk sends, with a copy of the notice of hearing, to the designated authority, or to the applicant and the originating court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A court's direction asking for further information or documents, with the court's reasons for requesting further evidence attached.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice the clerk prepares when the court receives further information or documents, and sends with copies of them to the respondent so the hearing can continue.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice the Ontario court clerk gives to a party believed to ordinarily reside in Ontario, saying that an order made outside Canada has been registered.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice the clerk sends to an applicant, with copies of the documents from the confirming court, when that court asks for further evidence about a provisional order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The version of the binding judicial dispute resolution hearing request and consent used by the Office of the Children's Lawyer, served and filed with a motion form.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 43A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit that may be used for a binding judicial dispute resolution hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 43B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A confirmation of a binding judicial dispute resolution hearing that each party gives to every other party, by mail, fax, email or another method, before giving it to the clerk.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 43C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An acknowledgment of expert's duty, signed by the expert.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 53; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice a party delivers to object to the proposed method of attendance at a hearing or step.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 1A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A request a party serves on every other party and files with proof of service, asking for an order for a stay or dismissal under rule 2.1.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.1A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice the registrar gives the parties, when the court directs, saying that the proceeding may be stayed or dismissed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.1B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of motion used to ask for a vexatious litigant order. It sets out the grounds for the order and is served on the person the order is sought against and on every party to a proceeding listed in the notice.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.2A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of application used to ask for a vexatious litigant order. It sets out the grounds for the order and is served on the person the order is sought against and on every party to a proceeding listed in the notice.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.2B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice a registrar prepares, when a judge gives written direction, proposing consideration of a vexatious litigant order against a party to an ongoing proceeding.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.2C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The response the person who may become the subject of a vexatious litigant order may serve and file within 20 days after receiving a notice about it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.2D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A reply that a moving party, applicant or notified person may serve and file about a possible vexatious litigant order, after a response is received or if no response is served.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.2E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order a judge makes after an initial review of the notice and submissions, either directing that a hearing be held or dismissing the matter, with reasons.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.2F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The vexatious litigant order a judge makes, with reasons, following a hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 2.2G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The standard heading placed on documents in an action. It sets out the name of the court, the court file number and the title of the proceeding.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 4A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for the general heading of documents in an application.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 4B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The backsheet placed on every document in a proceeding. It sets out details such as the short title of the proceeding, the court, the court file number and the title of the document.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 4C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form for an affidavit used in a proceeding. It is written in the first person, states the full name of the person making it, and is divided into numbered paragraphs.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 4D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A requisition a party files, paying any prescribed fee, when entitled to require the registrar to carry out a duty under the rules; a person entitled to see a document in the court file may also file one to obtain a certified copy.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 4E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for a notice of constitutional question under the Courts of Justice Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 4F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice the registrar sends to someone who started, continued or filed a document for a party under disability without filing the required affidavit. It requires the affidavit to be filed no later than 15 days after receipt of the notice.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 7A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A request another party serves on every other party and files with proof of service before that party may move to appoint a litigation guardian for a party known or believed to be under disability.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 7B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An order from the registrar allowing a minor who has reached the age of majority to continue the proceeding without the litigation guardian. It is obtained by filing an affidavit saying the minor has reached that age.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 7C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice a plaintiff or applicant suing a partnership in the firm name may serve with the originating process on a person, stating that the person was a partner at a material time, when seeking an order enforceable personally against that person as a partner.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 8A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An order from the registrar allowing a proceeding to continue when a party's interest or liability is transferred or transmitted while the proceeding is pending. It is obtained by filing an affidavit verifying the transfer or transmission.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 11A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The general statement of claim, the document that starts an action.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The statement of claim used to start a mortgage action for foreclosure.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to start an action when there is not enough time to prepare a statement of claim. It contains a short statement of the nature of the claim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The statement of claim a plaintiff files in an action that was started by a notice of action. The rule says it is filed within thirty days after the notice of action is issued.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of application, a document that starts an application. It states the exact relief sought, the grounds to be argued and the documentary evidence to be used at the hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of application used for an application under subsection 140 (3) of the Courts of Justice Act. It states the exact relief sought, the grounds to be argued and the documentary evidence to be used at the hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14E.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Information for court use, filed together with a statement of claim, notice of action or notice of application, unless that document is filed electronically through an online portal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 14F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a party who has a lawyer of record to change to a new lawyer. It gives the new lawyer's name, address and telephone number and is served and filed with proof of service.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 15A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a party acting in person to appoint a lawyer of record. It gives the lawyer's name, address and telephone number and is served on every other party and filed with proof of service.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 15B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a party with a lawyer of record to elect to act in person, giving an address for service and telephone number; served and filed with proof of service. Not available to a party under disability or acting in a representative capacity, or to a corporation without leave.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 15C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A card mailed with a document being served. Service this way is only effective as of the date the sender receives the card.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 16A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit by the person who served a document, used to prove that the document was served.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 16B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate a lawyer may use to prove service of a document that the lawyer served or had served.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 16B.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate used to prove that a sheriff served a document, either personally or at a place of residence.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 16C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A request for service of court or other legal documents abroad. It is one of the forms that can be used to prove service made in a country that is part of the Convention.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A summary of the document to be served, one of the Convention forms (17A to 17C) that the rules allow for proving service made in a contracting state under the Convention.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice and summary of a document being served. It is one of the forms that can be used to prove service made in a country that is part of the Convention.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 17C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The statement of defence, the document a defendant delivers after being served with a statement of claim. It may also include a counterclaim or a crossclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 18A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice that a defendant who has been served with a statement of claim and intends to defend may deliver within the time prescribed for delivery of a statement of defence. Delivering it gives ten more days to deliver the statement of defence.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 18B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form of default judgment used for a claim for a debt or liquidated demand in money, including interest if claimed in the statement of claim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 19A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form of default judgment used for a claim to recover possession of land.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 19B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form of default judgment used for a claim to recover possession of personal property.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 19C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The requisition a plaintiff files with the registrar before default judgment is signed. It states that the claim is one for which default judgment may be signed and whether any partial payment has been made.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 19D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A special case sets out the facts the parties agree on so the court can decide the question stated. It includes any documents needed and the relief the parties agree on.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 22A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a plaintiff to discontinue all or part of an action against a defendant before the close of pleadings. It is served on all parties who were served with the statement of claim and filed with proof of service.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 23A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a defendant who has counterclaimed to choose to go ahead with the counterclaim after the action is discontinued or dismissed for delay. The rules say it is delivered within thirty days after the discontinuance or the dismissal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 23B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a defendant to withdraw all or part of a statement of defence with respect to a plaintiff, delivered to all parties. Leave of the court is needed if the defendant has crossclaimed or made a third party claim, and withdrawing an admission is governed by rule 51.05.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 23C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice filed with the mediation co-ordinator stating the mediator's name and the date of the mediation session.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 24.1A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice the assigned mediator serves on every party giving the place, date, time and method of attendance for the mediation session, and advising that attendance is obligatory.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 24.1B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A statement of issues each party prepares and gives to every other party and to the mediator. The rule says this is done at least seven days before the mediation session.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 24.1C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate a mediator files with the mediation co-ordinator after cancelling a mediation session because a party did not provide the required statement of issues or did not attend within the first 30 minutes.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 24.1D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The reply, one of the pleadings in an action along with the statement of claim and the statement of defence, if there is one.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 25A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A counterclaim against parties to the main action only. It is included in the same document as the statement of defence, which is titled a statement of defence and counterclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 27A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A counterclaim against the plaintiff and a person not already a party to the main action. It is included in the same document as the statement of defence, which is titled a statement of defence and counterclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 27B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The defence to a counterclaim, delivered by the plaintiff and any other defendant to the counterclaim who is already a party to the main action. The rule says it is delivered within twenty days after service of the statement of defence and counterclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 27C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A reply to a defence to counterclaim, if there is one. The rule says it is delivered within ten days after service of the defence to counterclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 27D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A crossclaim, included in the same document as the statement of defence, which is titled a statement of defence and crossclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 28A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The defence to a crossclaim, one of the pleadings in a crossclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 28B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A reply to a defence to crossclaim, if there is one. The rule says it is delivered within ten days after service of the defence to crossclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 28C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for a third party claim, including a fourth or later party claim or a claim by a defendant to a counterclaim or crossclaim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The defence a third party delivers to defend against a third party claim. It is also used for a defence by a fourth or later party.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A reply to a third party defence, if there is one. The rule says it is delivered within ten days after service of the third party defence.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 29C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit of documents made by an individual party and served on every other party. It discloses all documents relevant to any matter in issue in the action that are or have been in the party's possession, control or power.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 30A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit of documents made by a corporation or partnership and served on every other party. It discloses all documents relevant to any matter in issue in the action that are or have been in the party's possession, control or power.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 30B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A request one party serves on another to inspect documents that are not privileged and are listed in the other party's affidavit of documents.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 30C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of examination served when the person to be examined is a party to the proceeding. It is served on the party's lawyer of record, or on the party if acting in person.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A summons to witness for an examination out of court, served personally on a person who lives in Ontario and is neither a party nor a person referred to in subrule (2) or (3).
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A commission authorizing a named commissioner to take evidence from a person who is to be examined outside Ontario.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A letter of request to the judicial authorities where a person outside Ontario is found, asking them to issue what is needed to make that person attend and be examined.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The court order used when a person is to be examined outside Ontario. If the moving party asks, it provides for issuing a commission and a letter of request.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 34E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A list of written questions for an examination for discovery, served on the person to be examined and every other party.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 35A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit giving the answers of the person being examined to written questions on an examination for discovery. The rule says it is served on the examining party within fifteen days after service of the list of questions.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 35B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of motion, the document used to make a motion unless the nature of the motion or the circumstances make it unnecessary or the rules say otherwise.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A confirmation of motion that a party making a motion on notice gives the registrar before the hearing, by email or at the court office, with a copy emailed to the other party. A responding party may give one if the moving party fails to send a copy.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A chart the moving party serves and files on a motion to compel answers or have undertakings satisfied, setting out each issue, the question number with its transcript page, and the exact words of the question. The responding party completes and returns it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 37C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of appearance, which a respondent who has been served with a notice of application delivers right away (forthwith).
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 38A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A confirmation of application that a party making an application on notice gives the registrar before the hearing, by email or at the court office, with a copy emailed to the other party. A corrected one is given if it is no longer correct.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 38B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate of pending litigation under the Courts of Justice Act, which a registrar may issue only under an order of the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 42A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An interpleader order about property that two or more other persons claim. It is sought by a person who claims no beneficial interest in the property and is willing to deposit it with the court or deal with it as the court directs.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 43A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A bond given as security in a proceeding for interim recovery of personal property. It stays in force until the security is released.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 44A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a party to an action to have the issues of fact tried, or damages assessed, or both, by a jury. The rule says it is delivered at any time before the close of pleadings, unless a statute requires trial without a jury.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 47A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order the registrar makes, unless the court orders otherwise and subject to exceptions, dismissing an action for delay that was not set down for trial or terminated by the fifth anniversary of its start, or was struck off a trial list and not restored by the second anniversary.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 48D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An offer to settle one or more of the claims in a proceeding, which a party may serve on any other party on the terms set out in the offer.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 49A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice that may be used to withdraw an offer to settle.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 49B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to accept an offer to settle by serving it on the party who made the offer, before the offer is withdrawn or the court disposes of the claim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 49C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An offer one defendant may serve on another to contribute toward settling a claim, where two or more defendants are alleged to be jointly, or jointly and severally, liable to the plaintiff.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 49D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by the plaintiff to record the terms of a partial settlement agreement, other than any money amount. A copy is served on every other party and filed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 49E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate of readiness each party delivers before a pre-trial conference. It shows whether the party intends to call expert evidence at trial and gives details about each expert's report.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 50A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A request asking another party to admit, for the purposes of the proceeding only, that a fact is true or a document is authentic.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 51A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The response a party gives to a request to admit, served on the party who made the request. The rule says it is served within twenty days after the request is served.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 51B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A summons a party may serve on a person in Ontario to attend a trial as a witness at the time and place stated. It may also require the witness to bring related documents or other things.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 53A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A warrant for arrest a presiding judge may issue when a witness whose evidence is material, who was served with a summons and paid or tendered proper attendance money, fails to attend or remain at the trial as the summons requires, so the witness is apprehended anywhere in Ontario.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 53B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A summons used to compel a witness outside Ontario to attend, under the Interprovincial Summonses Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 53C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An order the court may make directing the officer who has custody of a prisoner to bring them for an examination or to a hearing as a witness, where their evidence is material to an action.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 53D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of a hearing for directions on a reference, served on every other party to the proceeding together with a copy of the order directing the reference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 55A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice served on a person the referee adds as a party during a reference, together with the order adding them and the order directing the reference. Once served, the person becomes a party.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 55B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form for a report on a reference in a proceeding to administer the estate of a person who has died.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 55C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice served on a claimant when their claim is contested on a reference, fixing a date for the claim to be decided.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 55D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice served on each creditor when money is to be paid out of court to creditors, saying that payment of the creditor's claim, as allowed, may be obtained from the Accountant.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 55E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The standard conditions of sale for a sale by auction or tender on a reference, subject to any changes the referee directs.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 55F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An interim report a referee may make on the result of a sale.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 55G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An order for security for costs. Until the security is given, the plaintiff or applicant it is made against may not take any step in the proceeding except an appeal from the order, unless the court orders otherwise.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 56A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A bill of costs that a party who is awarded costs serves on the other parties and files with proof of service. This happens after a trial, a motion that ends a proceeding, or the hearing of an application.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 57A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A costs outline, no more than three pages long, that a party intending to seek costs for a step in a proceeding gives to every other party involved in that step and brings to the hearing, unless the parties have agreed on the costs for that step.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 57B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of appointment for assessment of costs, obtained from the assessment officer by a party entitled to costs after filing a bill of costs and the document giving the right to costs.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 58A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice a party liable to pay costs may obtain from the assessment officer when the party entitled to costs does not file or serve a bill of costs for assessment within a reasonable time.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 58B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate in which the assessment officer sets out the amount of costs assessed and allowed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 58C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form for an order, including a draft order. It contains the name of the person who made the order, the date it was made, and the details needed to understand it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 59A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for a judgment. The rules mention a draft in this form being filed with a requisition after a judge declines to make a vexatious litigant order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 59B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for an order on appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 59C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice of an appointment to have an order settled, served on the other parties who took part in the hearing or conference and filed with proof of service. The rules say this is at least seven days before the appointment.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 59D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A writ of seizure and sale, one way to enforce an order for paying or recovering money. A creditor obtains it by filing a requisition with the registrar where the proceeding was started.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A writ of sequestration directing a sheriff to take and hold the property of a person against whom an order was made, and collect its income, until the person complies. It may be issued only with leave of the court, obtained on motion.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A writ of possession, used to enforce an order for the recovery or delivery of possession of land. It may be issued only with leave of the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A writ of delivery, used to enforce an order for the recovery of possession of personal property other than money. It is obtained by filing a requisition with the registrar along with a copy of the order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A request filed with the sheriff to renew a writ of seizure and sale before it expires. The sheriff records the renewal date and the new expiration date.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A direction filed with the sheriff, along with a copy of the order, to enforce a writ of seizure and sale. It sets out details such as the date of the order, the amount awarded and the interest rate.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A requisition a creditor files with the registrar to enforce an order for payment or recovery of money by garnishment, together with a copy of the order and an affidavit.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Filed with the registrar, together with an affidavit, to renew a notice of garnishment before it expires.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60G.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of garnishment the registrar issues once the creditor's requisition and affidavit are filed. It names as garnishees the people listed in the affidavit.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60H; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of renewal of garnishment the registrar issues once a requisition for renewal and affidavit are filed. It names as garnishees the people listed in the affidavit.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60H.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A garnishee's statement. A blank copy is attached to the notice of garnishment served on the garnishee; a garnishee who disputes the garnishment or pays the sheriff less than the notice's amount serves it on the creditor and debtor and files it.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60I; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served by a creditor on co-owners of a debt, with a copy of the garnishee's statement, when that statement shows the debt is owed to the debtor and to one or more co-owners.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60I.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served by the creditor on the garnishee and the sheriff when the amount owing under an order enforced by garnishment has been paid.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60J; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A warrant a judge may issue to arrest a person against whom a contempt order is sought, when the judge thinks the person's attendance at the hearing is necessary and the person is not likely to attend voluntarily.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60K; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A warrant of committal, which the rules say may be used to enforce an order for imprisonment that a judge makes after a finding of contempt on a motion for a contempt order.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60L; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice a sheriff gives every creditor who has filed an enforcement process, after someone claims property the sheriff took or intended to take. Within seven days after receiving it, each creditor gives the sheriff written notice admitting or disputing the claim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60M; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The report a sheriff mails or emails to a party or lawyer who filed a writ and asked in writing how the sheriff carried out that writ.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60N; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A written request a debtor gives the sheriff to withdraw a writ when the judgment debt has been released by an order of discharge or certificate of full performance under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 60O; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to ask the Divisional Court for permission (leave) to appeal. The notice states that the motion will be heard on a date fixed by the Registrar.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to ask the Court of Appeal for permission (leave) to appeal. The notice states that the motion will be heard on a date fixed by the Registrar.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61A.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to start an appeal to the Court of Appeal. It states the relief sought, the grounds of appeal, and the basis for the court's power to hear the appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61A.2; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to start an appeal to the Divisional Court. It states the relief sought, the grounds of appeal, and the basis for the court's power to hear the appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61A.3; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Shows the heading used on any document filed in an appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served and filed by the appellant with the notice of appeal, listing only the parts of the evidence that the appellant thinks are needed for the appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served and filed by the respondent in an appeal to confirm the appellant's certificate respecting evidence, or to add or remove parts of the evidence it lists.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to bring a cross-appeal. It states the relief sought and the grounds, and is served on all parties whose interests may be affected by the cross-appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to change a notice of appeal or cross-appeal without the court's permission, before the appeal is perfected. It is served on the parties who got the original notice and filed with proof of service.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice the Registrar sends to everyone listed in the certificate of perfection once an appeal is perfected and placed on the list of cases to be heard.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate in the appeal book and compendium stating that its contents are complete. The rules describe it as signed by the appellant's lawyer or someone the lawyer has authorized.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61H; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order the Registrar makes dismissing an appeal or cross-appeal for delay, with fixed costs, in the situations the rules describe.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61I; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order the Registrar makes, unless the court orders otherwise, dismissing an appeal to the Divisional Court for delay when the appeal has not been set down for hearing or otherwise ended within the time the rule sets, unless the appellant is under a disability.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61I.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order the Registrar makes dismissing a motion for leave to appeal for delay, with fixed costs.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61J; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order the Registrar makes dismissing a motion in an appeal court for delay, with fixed costs, when the moving party does not serve and file the needed documents in time, as the rules describe.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61J.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Delivered by a party to abandon (drop) an appeal or cross-appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61K; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Delivered by a respondent who cross-appealed, when the appeal is dismissed for delay or abandoned, to say they elect to go ahead with the cross-appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61L; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of a motion, other than a motion for leave to appeal, that will be heard by a single judge of the Court of Appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61M; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of a motion, other than a motion for leave to appeal, that will be heard by a single judge of the Divisional Court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61N; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of a motion, other than a motion for leave to appeal, that will be heard by a panel of judges of the Court of Appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61O; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of a motion, other than a motion for leave to appeal, that will be heard by a panel of judges of the Divisional Court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 61P; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to start an appeal to a judge. It is served on all parties whose interests may be affected and states the relief sought and the grounds of appeal.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 62A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Issued by the registrar, when a party to the appeal asks, when an order is stayed. Once it is filed with the sheriff, the sheriff does not start or continue enforcing the order until satisfied the stay has ended.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 63A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A certificate of stay for an order of the Landlord and Tenant Board stayed under the Statutory Powers Procedure Act, issued by the appeal court's registrar when a party to the appeal asks. Once it is filed, the sheriff does not enforce the order until the stay ends.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 63B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served and filed by a defendant in a foreclosure or sale action who wishes to redeem the mortgaged property.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The default judgment for foreclosure with a reference that the registrar signs when the plaintiff wants a reference about subsequent encumbrancers.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The default judgment for immediate foreclosure that the registrar signs at the plaintiff's request when a defendant in a foreclosure action is noted in default and has not filed a request to redeem, and the plaintiff does not want a reference about subsequent encumbrancers.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A default judgment for foreclosure of a mortgage without a reference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A final order of foreclosure the plaintiff may get on motion without notice against a subsequent encumbrancer who was served with a notice of reference but did not attend and prove a claim, once the referee has reported this and the report is confirmed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served on the plaintiff and filed, with proof of service, by a defendant in a foreclosure action who wishes a sale instead, within the time the rules set. A subsequent encumbrancer must also pay security into court and give verified particulars of the claim.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A default judgment for sale with a redemption period, in an action converted from foreclosure to sale. The registrar signs it at the plaintiff's request after a request for sale.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A default judgment for immediate sale, in an action converted from foreclosure to sale. The registrar signs it at the plaintiff's request after a request for sale.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64H; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A default judgment for sale in an action converted from foreclosure to sale, conditional on a subsequent encumbrancer proving their claim. The registrar signs it at the plaintiff's request.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64I; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The default judgment for immediate sale with a reference that the registrar signs when a defendant in a sale action is noted in default and has not filed a request to redeem.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64J; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A default judgment for sale with a redemption period. The registrar signs it when a defendant in a sale action is noted in default and has filed a request to redeem.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64K; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A final order for sale that may be obtained on motion without notice when no defendant filed a request to redeem and no subsequent encumbrancer attended and proved a claim on the reference, once the referee has reported this and the report is confirmed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64L; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The default judgment for redemption that the registrar signs in a redemption action when the defendant has been noted in default.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64M; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of reference served on a subsequent encumbrancer who is added as a defendant on the reference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64N; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice of reference the referee directs be served on a defendant named in the statement of claim who was not alleged there to be a subsequent encumbrancer but appears to have a lien, charge or encumbrance on the mortgaged property.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64O; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served on those named as defendants in the statement of claim, listing all appearing to have a lien, charge or encumbrance on the mortgaged property and their claims. A named subsequent encumbrancer who filed no request to redeem or for sale is not entitled to notice of a foreclosure reference.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64P; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A notice served on a defendant added on the reference who has an interest in the equity, together with the order and the judgment in the action.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 64Q; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A judgment for administration of an estate. The rules say it is granted only if the judge is satisfied the questions between the parties cannot otherwise be properly decided.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 65A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form of a judgment for partition or sale.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 66A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to start an application to the Divisional Court for judicial review. It states the exact relief sought, the grounds to be argued, and the documentary evidence to be used at the hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 68A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice the registrar sends to the parties and others named in the certificate of perfection once a judicial review application is placed on the list for hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 68B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order the registrar makes dismissing a judicial review application for delay, with costs fixed at $750, when the applicant does not fix the default within the time allowed after notice.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 68C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The order the Registrar makes, unless the court orders otherwise, dismissing an application for judicial review for delay when the application has not been set down for hearing or otherwise ended within the time the rule sets, unless the applicant is under a disability.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 68D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Served on every interested party by a person who pays money into court under an offer to settle or an acceptance of an offer. It is not filed with the court.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 72A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The affidavit that supports a motion to a judge for payment out of court of money held to the credit of a person under disability, except a motion made by the Children's Lawyer or the Public Guardian and Trustee.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 72B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An order the court may make, on a motion or application without notice by a person who claims to be entitled to money or securities held by the Accountant for another person's benefit, directing that they not be dealt with except on notice to that person.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 72C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to start an application to register a United Kingdom judgment. It states the exact relief sought, the grounds to be argued, and the documentary evidence to be used at the hearing.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 73A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to apply for a certificate of appointment of estate trustee. It is filed with other documents the rules list, such as proof of service and proof of death.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74A; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit used as proof of service of an application for a certificate of appointment of estate trustee.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74B; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The form used for a lawyer's certificate of service of an application for a certificate of appointment of estate trustee.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74B.1; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The certificate of appointment of estate trustee. A draft is filed with the application, with a copy of any will and codicils attached.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74C; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit about the signing (execution) of a will or codicil, which may be deposited with it. In applications for a certificate of appointment of estate trustee or a small estate certificate, a non-holograph will or codicil is attached as an exhibit to it or other evidence the rule describes.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74D; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit about the condition of a will or codicil at the time it was signed. It is used where the will or codicil has an alteration, erasure or other change that was not attested.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74E; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: An affidavit stating that the handwriting and signature in a holograph will or codicil are those of the person who died.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74F; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used by a person to renounce a right to act as estate trustee, or to consent to an application, in the estate situations the rules describe.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74G; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A form titled Consent, in the series of forms for non-contentious estates proceedings under the Rules of Civil Procedure. No rule on file names this form, so the particular consent it records is not described here.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74H; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A form for an order in an estates proceeding. The rules use it as a draft order, for example one granting a certificate of appointment of estate trustee with a will limited to the assets referred to in the will.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74I; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Used to apply for a certificate or confirmation of appointment, such as for a foreign estate trustee's nominee without a will, or for a succeeding estate trustee with a will.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74J; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The nomination of the applicant by the estate trustee appointed where the deceased was domiciled at death, filed with an application by a foreign estate trustee's nominee.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74K; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A bond from an insurer licensed to write surety and fidelity insurance in Ontario, used as the security required by the Estates Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74L; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: A bond from one or more personal sureties, used as the security required by the Estates Act.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74M; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice the registrar sends, with a copy of the application, to the estate trustee named in a will or codicil deposited with the court when that deposited will prevents confirmation.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74N; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The notice the registrar sends to an applicant for a certificate of appointment of estate trustee when the registrar refuses to issue the certificate, or when a notice of objection is filed.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74O; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: Filed with the registrar by a person with an interest in an estate who wants to be told when a proceeding in the estate starts.
appears_in: Forms guide, Form 74P; the case forms page card for the same form

current_text: The estate trustee's affidavit verifying the estate accounts, filed on an application to pass accounts.
